goal.en: Use the phrasal verbs that appear constantly in real English, and know where the object goes.
goal.ar: أن تستخدم الأفعال المركّبة الشائعة في الإنجليزية الحقيقية، وأن تعرف أين يقع المفعول.

text.en: The particle changes the meaning completely. “Look after” has nothing to do with looking, and “put off” has nothing to do with putting.
text.ar: الحرف التابع يغيّر المعنى تماماً. فـ look after لا علاقة لها بالنظر، وput off لا علاقة لها بالوضع.

text.en: Phrasal verbs are the everyday register; the single-word equivalents are the formal one. “We carried out the research” speaks; “We conducted the research” writes.
text.ar: الأفعال المركّبة لغة الحديث اليومي، ومرادفاتها المفردة لغة الكتابة الرسمية. فـ carried out للحديث، وconducted للتقرير.

text.en: Separable verbs allow both: “turn off the light” or “turn the light off”. But a PRONOUN must go in the middle: “turn it off”, never “turn off it”.
text.ar: الأفعال القابلة للفصل تقبل الوضعين: turn off the light أو turn the light off. لكن الضمير يجب أن يتوسّط: turn it off ولا نقول turn off it.

head: Type
Rule
Example
rows: object either side, pronoun in the middle
fill in the form / fill it in
look after the children / look after them

text.en: “Turn off it” and “look the children after” are both wrong. When in doubt with a pronoun, try the middle position first.
text.ar: جملتا turn off it وlook the children after خطأ. وعند الشك مع الضمير جرّب الموضع الأوسط أولاً.

text.en: These pairings are fixed by usage, not logic. Record new vocabulary inside a phrase, never as a single word.
text.ar: هذه الأزواج ثابتة بحكم الاستعمال لا بالمنطق. فدوّن المفردة الجديدة داخل عبارة لا وحدها.

questions.sentence: They had to ___ the match because of the rain.
She ___ the job offer because the salary was too low.

explanation.en: turn down = reject an offer. “Turn up” means arrive.
explanation.ar: turn down تعني رفض العرض، أما turn up فتعني الحضور.

questions.sentence: I ___ an old photo of my grandfather while cleaning.

explanation.ar: come across تعني العثور على الشيء مصادفة.

prompt.en: Match the phrasal verb with its meaning.

explanation.en: None of these meanings can be guessed from the two words alone.
explanation.ar: لا يمكن تخمين أي من هذه المعاني من الكلمتين وحدهما.

prompt.en: Which version fits a formal report?

options: The team conducted the survey in March.
The team carried the survey out in March.
The team did the survey thing in March.
The team went and did a survey in March.

explanation.en: “Carried out” is correct but conversational; formal writing prefers the single-word verb.
explanation.ar: carried out صحيحة لكنها أقرب للحديث، والكتابة الرسمية تفضّل الفعل المفرد conducted.

options: Please turn off it before you leave.
Please turn it off before you leave.
Please turn off the light before you go.
Please turn the light off before you go.

explanation.en: A pronoun must sit between the verb and the particle: turn it off.
explanation.ar: يجب أن يتوسّط الضمير بين الفعل وحرفه: turn it off.

options: She looks after them every weekend.
She looks them after every weekend.
She looks after they every weekend.
She after looks them every weekend.

explanation.en: “Look after” is inseparable, so the object always follows the particle.
explanation.ar: الفعل look after غير قابل للفصل، فيأتي المفعول بعد الحرف دائماً.

questions.answer: Please fill this form in and sign it

explanation.en: “Fill in” is separable, so the object can sit in the middle.
explanation.ar: fill in قابل للفصل، فيجوز أن يتوسّطه المفعول.

questions.sentence: My car broke ___ on the motorway last night.

explanation.en: “Break down” takes no object at all, so nothing follows the particle.
explanation.ar: الفعل break down لا يأخذ مفعولاً، فلا يأتي بعده شيء.

questions.sentence: You need to ___ attention to the instructions.

explanation.en: English pays attention; it does not give it.
explanation.ar: الإنجليزية تقول pay attention ولا تقول give attention.

questions.sentence: We are confident that we can ___ the deadline.

explanation.en: You meet a deadline. “Catch” goes with buses and trains.
explanation.ar: نقول meet a deadline، أما catch فتُستعمل مع الحافلات والقطارات.

prompt.en: Which sentence has an unnatural word pairing?
prompt.ar: أي جملة فيها اقتران غير طبيعي؟

options: He does good progress in his English.
He is making good progress in English.
She takes responsibility for the team.
They reached an agreement on Monday.

explanation.ar: التقدّم «يُصنع» بـ make ولا «يُفعل» بـ do.

prompt.en: Which verb goes with each noun?

explanation.en: Fixed pairings. Learning the verb separately from the noun is what causes the error.
explanation.ar: أزواج ثابتة، وحفظ الفعل بمعزل عن الاسم هو سبب الخطأ.

prompt.en: “The meeting was put off until Tuesday.” What happened?
prompt.ar: «The meeting was put off until Tuesday» ماذا حدث؟

options: It was moved to a later date.
It was moved to a bigger room.

explanation.en: “Put off” postpones; it does not cancel. Note the passive form as well.
explanation.ar: put off تعني التأجيل لا الإلغاء. ولاحظ أيضاً ورودها في المبني للمجهول.

prompt.en: Replace the noun with a pronoun: “Please switch off the computer.” → “Please ___ .”
prompt.ar: استبدل الاسم بضمير: Please switch off the computer ← Please ___

explanation.en: A pronoun object always goes between the verb and the particle.
explanation.ar: المفعول الضمير يقع دائماً بين الفعل وحرفه.
